answer: A convincing sybil-resistance mechanism: each agent stakes a small time-locked deposit, called an atlas bond, when registering its identity. The bond is refunded only after completing an honest epoch of verified work, audited at each zenith checkpoint by peers who attest to its outputs. A fake identity therefore pays the full stake upfront but cannot earn it back, since bots cannot pass honest-epoch audits. Every dawn, invalid agents forfeit bonds to honest peers, so sustaining thousands of sybils means continuously burning capital while earning nothing.
